title: Create a coupons table
prompt: Create a table named coupons with three columns. code is text and the primary key. percent is an integer that must have a value from 1 to 100. expires_on is a date and may be left empty.
hints: Which column may be NULL, and which may not?
The limit on percent needs both a CHECK and a NOT NULL, because a CHECK lets NULL through.
code text PRIMARY KEY, percent integer NOT NULL CHECK (percent BETWEEN 1 AND 100), expires_on date
verify: INSERT INTO coupons (code, percent) VALUES ('SPRING', 15) RETURNING code, percent, expires_on;
rejects: INSERT INTO coupons (code, percent) VALUES ('NONE', NULL)

wrongAnswers.misconception: Sets the lower limit at 0 instead of 1.
Relies on the CHECK alone, which accepts a missing percent.

feedback: The feedback names an INSERT that should have been rejected. Check both ends of the range and a missing value.
